title: Turn the block, read the corner
summary: A number x between minus one and one can live inside a turn: x = cos θ is the shadow of a dial's hand, and the top-left corner of the 2×2 signal block W(x). Multiplying the block by itself adds the angles, so the corner of W(x)^m reads cos mθ, the Chebyshev polynomial T_m(x). At x = 0.6 the corner reads 1, 0.6, −0.28, −0.936, −0.8432, and each new reading is 2x times the last minus the one before; no angle is needed. The reason: the block's eigenvalues a and b have product one and sum 2x, and Lean checks that in any commutative ring two elements with product one have power sums obeying that rule. In the QSVT literature a matrix splits into one such block per singular value, and phase twists between the turns produce other polynomials; Lean checks that a polynomial pair with the right degree, parity and balance is built exactly by a starting phase φ₀ and a list of exactly k more phases. Existence only: no recipe for the phases, no claim of uniqueness or of the shortest list; the unification of algorithms as polynomial transformations is a literature result not formalized in the book.
summary_zh: 一个介于 −1 与 1 之间的数 x 可以藏在一次转动里：x = cos θ 是表盘指针的影子，也是二乘二信号块 W(x) 的左上角。方块自乘时角度相加，所以 W(x)^m 的左上角读出 cos mθ，即切比雪夫多项式 T_m(x)。取 x = 0.6，角落依次读出 1、0.6、−0.28、−0.936、−0.8432，每个新读数都等于 2x 乘上一个再减去更前一个，用不着角度。原因在于：方块的两个特征值 a、b 乘积为 1、和为 2x，而 Lean 检验了在任意交换环里乘积为 1 的两个元素的幂和服从这条规则。按 QSVT 的文献结果，一个矩阵拆成每个奇异值一块；在转动之间插入相位扭转，可以得到别的多项式。Lean 检验了：次数、奇偶与归一都合格的一对多项式，恰好由一个起始相位 φ₀ 与一串恰好 k 个相位拼出。这只是存在性：不给出求相位的方法，也不声称唯一或最短；把各种算法统一成多项式变换是文献结果，本书没有形式化。
